ja429:1.1: Dumo yadā hoti phalūpapanno bhuñjanti naṃ vihagā sampatantā, khīṇan ti ñatvāna dumaṃ phalaccaye disodisaṃ yanti tato vihaṅgamā ti.
ja429:2.1: Cara cārikaṃ lohitatuṇḍa mā cari, kiṃ tvaṃ suva sukkhadumamhi jhāyasi, tad iṃgha maṃ brūhi vasantasannibha: kasmā suva sukkhadumaṃ na riñcasīti.
ja429:3.1: Ye ve sakhīnaṃ sakhāro bhavanti pāṇaccaye sukhadukkhesu haṃsa khīṇaṃ akhīṇan ti na taṃ jahanti santo sataṃ dhammam anussarantā.
ja429:4.1: So 'haṃ sataṃ aññataro 'smi haṃsa, ñātī ca me hoti sakhā ca rukkho, taṃ n' ussahe jīvikattho pahātuṃ khīṇan ti ñatvāna, na h' esa dhammo ti.
ja429:5.1: Sādhu sakkhi kataṃ hoti metti saṃsati santhavo, sac' etaṃ dhammaṃ rocesi pāsaṃso si vijānataṃ.
ja429:6.1: So te suva varaṃ dammi pattayāna vihaṅgama, (Cfr. p..) varaṃ varassu vakkaṅga yaṃ kiñci manas' icchasīti.
ja429:7.1: Varaṃ ce me haṃsa tuvaṃ dadeyya ayaṃ rukkho punar āyuṃ labhetha, so sākhavā phalimā saṃvirūḷho madhatthiko tiṭṭhatu sobhamāno
ja429:8.1: ti. Taṃ passa samma phalimaṃ uḷāraṃ, sabhā va te hotu udumbarena, so sākhavā phalimā saṃvirūḷho madhatthiko tiṭṭhatu sobhamāno ti.
ja429:9.1: Evaṃ Sakka sukhī hohi saha sabbehi ñātibhi (Cfr. p. 495.) yathāham ajja sukhito disvāna phalitaṃ duman ti.
ja429:10.1: Suvassa ca varaṃ datvā katvāna saphalaṃ dumaṃ (Cfr. p..) pakkāmi saha bhariyāya devānaṃ Nandanaṃ vanan ti.
